Why is it thought that the climate on Mars changed when the planet lost its strong magnetic field?
Option A: without a strong magnetic field the ozone layer was destroyed by the solar wind which stopped the greenhouse effect and cooled Mars down.
Option B: without a strong magnetic field which enhances the greenhouse effect Mars cooled down.
Option C: without a strong magnetic field the solar wind stripped away most of the atmosphere significantly reducing the greenhouse effect and cooling Mars down
Option D: without a strong magnetic field the planet recieves fewer charged particles from the solar wind and therefore is not heated as much
